### Scope

The triage (`5827630781`): show a lookup the way other faces do (its display name, or its id), and make the search read a string. ⛔ No change to the spec key. Reuse the shared display-name resolver other faces use for an expanded lookup. ⛔ Don't write a third one. Pin: an expanded `{ id, name }` description renders its name and the popup no longer throws; a bare id renders as text; the search matches on the displayed string.

⇒ `Fixes #10456`.
